[OpenLeft]I've heard Lyon changed when he acquired[LF]
the Dark Stone.[.][A][LF]
I've no interest in magic, but[ToggleMouthMove]...[.][ToggleMouthMove][LF]
There was something uncanny about him.[A][LF]
It seemed almost as though he were being[LF]
controlled by something himself.[A]
[OpenFarLeft][ToggleMouthMove]......[ToggleMouthMove][A]
[OpenRight]The two of you might find this hard[.][LF]
to accept, but[ToggleMouthMove]...[.][ToggleMouthMove][A][LF]
The state of Prince Lyon's heart matters[LF]
little. He has the Dark Stone.[A][LF]
That rock is the cause of all that's[LF]
happened. The prince must be stopped.[.][A][BreakTalk]

[OpenFarRight]Not yet. There is something[.][LF]
that needs doing first.[.][A]
[OpenFarLeft]L'Arachel?[A]
[OpenFarRight]Prince Ephraim, I do believe you[LF]
felt it as well.[A][LF]
The Dark Stone held by Prince Lyon[ToggleMouthMove]...[.][ToggleMouthMove][LF]
It exudes a malefic miasma[ToggleMouthMove]...[.][ToggleMouthMove][A][LF]
We might be able to handle Prince Lyon[LF]
alone, but that stone is beyond our ken.[A]
[OpenFarLeft]Then what do you suggest?[.][A]
[OpenFarRight]The Sacred Stones.[A]
[OpenFarLeft]The Sacred Stones?[A]
[OpenFarRight]We've all heard the legend of the[.][LF]
five Sacred Stones.[.][A][LF]
They alone possessed the power to[.][LF]
seal the Demon King away forever.[.][A][LF]
So, of course, to dispel demonic[LF]
magic, we must use the Sacred Stones![.][A]
[OpenRight]You expect us to pin the outcome[LF]
of this war on some fool legend?[A]
[OpenLeft][ToggleMouthMove]...[.][ToggleMouthMove]Not just the legend.[LF]
We also have hope.[A][CloseSpeechSlow]
[OpenLeft]According to Lyon,[A][LF]
he has already seen to the destruction of[.][LF]
Grado's, Frelia's, and Jehanna's stones.[A]
[OpenFarLeft]Hm. That explains something[.][ToggleMouthMove]...[.][ToggleMouthMove][A][LF]
Grado forces attacked me, intent on[.][LF]
destroying the Stone of Renais.[.][A][LF]
If that could be the reason they[LF]
chose to invade Renais[ToggleMouthMove]...[.][ToggleMouthMove][A][LF]
The power of the Sacred Stones may[LF]
be greater than we'd ever known.[A]
[OpenFarRight]Yes, exactly![.][A][LF]
If we acquire a Sacred Stone, we'll be[LF]
able to oppose the Dark Stone's might![A]
[OpenRight]But three of the stones have been[.][LF]
shattered, and our options are few.[.][A][LF]
Do you suppose that, during the[.][LF]
invasion of Renais[ToggleMouthMove]...[.][ToggleMouthMove][A]
[OpenLeft]No, I don't think so.[.][A][LF]
The Stone of Renais is hidden by the[LF]
power of Eirika's and my bracelets.[.][A]
[OpenFarLeft]Grado has made many attempts[LF]
to take our bracelets.[A][LF]
Every one has failed, and so[LF]
the stone may still be safe.[A]
[OpenLeft]We have to confirm that, of course.[.][A][LF]
We've defeated Grado, and we must[.][LF]
turn our eyes to our homeland.[A][LF]
It's time to return to Renais.[A][X]
